summary.text: Elma Hairston is the Democratic candidate for the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 59, in the November 3, 2026 general election; she advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary.
Her campaign website lists expanding affordable, accessible healthcare, strong public education and strategy-based budgeting among her priorities.
